job.question: Which retirement system's investment consultant RFP requires firms to certify that they currently provide investment consulting services to clients whose combined assets total at least $50 billion?
job.expected_facts: Teachers' Retirement System of the State of Illinois (TRS Illinois), in its FY23 investment consultant RFP (Appendix B, Statement of Minimum Qualifications).
job.acceptance: TRS Illinois / Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois is sufficient; FY23 and appendix identifier are optional.

reviews.reason: The document identifies TRS Illinois, but it is an August 2024 private-equity consultant RFP. Its minimum qualification specifies at least $10 billion in private-equity portfolio assets, not the required certification concerning current consulting clients with combined assets of at least $50 billion.
quotes: Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR PRIVATE EQUITY INVESTMENT CONSULTANT SERVICES Issued August 7, 2024
APPENDIX B: STATEMENT OF MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
The firm and/or its principals have experience providing private equity consulting services to clients, in aggregate, with private equity portfolio assets of at least $10 billion.
